name: 85015 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85015 (Phoenix) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85015 (Phoenix) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85015 (Phoenix) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
